relationships.subject: miR-21
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of mmu-miR-21 led to overexpression of Toll Like Receptor 8 (Tlr8).

relationships.subject: miR-218
relationships.evidence_quote: rno-miR-218 downregulated the expression of Socs3, thus, activating JAK/STAT3 inflammatory signaling

relationships.subject: miR-15a/16
relationships.evidence_quote: increased expression of rno-miR-15a and rno-miR-16 downregulated the expression of Grk2 leading to the development of neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: miR-142-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: Adenylate cyclase 9 (Ac9) and cAMP levels were significantly reduced in CCI rats.

key_findings: Review of miRNA regulatory networks in neuropathic pain across human, mouse and rat, including miR-21/Tlr8, miR-218/Socs3/STAT3 and miR-15a/16/Grk2 axes.
miRNAs act through IRAK/TRAF6, TLR4/NF-kB and NLRP3 inflammasome signaling.
